title: Folder permission
description: One yes the person gave the side-panel agent "for this folder", kept across sessions in `.visionboard/permissions.json`, which only the server writes. It covers writes in one folder of the board's folder (`path`, relative to it, `''` for the folder itself, not its subfolders), reads of one file (`read`), searches of one folder (`search`), or a `command` by its first words (`command`). It never covers a path the access rules refuse.

id.description: The permission's id; forget_permission names it.

kind.description: What it allows: writes in the folder `path`, reads of the file `path`, searches of the folder `path`, or a `command`.

path.description: For a write or a search, the folder it covers; for a read, the file; relative to the board's folder, `/`-joined; `''` is the board's folder itself.

command.description: For a command: the first words it covers, such as `npm test`.
